summary: Concord's Domain registry enacts seven child Domains under the Product root: durable-authority, workflow-engine, agent-surface, product-memory, work-coordination, operator-surface, and repository-verification. Every current law record declares one home_domain_id; eight Product-wide records stay at the root and 21 straddling records declare bounded applies_to_domain_ids. No Domain enters the registry owning no law, which defers predecessor-migration until its first law exists. Architecture relations carry governing_law_ids, and Domain identity is never inferred from a record's title.
title: The Domain registry enacts seven child Domains
